doubts.claim_under_doubt: the operator approves only what they read: a changed row is marked and locked
doubts.disproof_attempt: A lead replaces a proposal with one under a NEW timestamp in the same position; the refetch mounts a fresh row that is unmarked and clickable, so the changed marker never fires.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Mark every row that appears after the first load as new since the window was opened, with the same lock and acknowledgement.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: different from residueKind means the lead really rewrote the proposal
doubts.disproof_attempt: proposalFingerprint hashes the block with only CR removed and the end trimmed: a whitespace-only edit of approved residue reads as different and Reject would record it as rejected.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Normalise, or document that a whitespace-only rewrite reads as different.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: any-reason reuse only reuses this webui's own record
doubts.disproof_attempt: A same-OS-user lead can plant a record with any reason; that text is echoed in the notice as if it were the operator's.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Label the text as read from the audit file and state the widened pre-emption as accepted.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a pinned done result of an older version is always shown on its own
doubts.disproof_attempt: settled is keyed by row key only: a second done for another version overwrites the first.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Key settled by key and digest.

summary: 1 high, 2 medium, 1 low; high and low fixed, medium 1 documented as accepted, medium 2 reworded and documented.
